files.content: # StatusPill, Badge and CountBadge examples Status pills (tinted fill, tinted edge, deep ink), small uppercase tags, and count badges. ```tsx import { Badge, CountBadge, StatusPill } from "@/components/ui"; Paid ``` ## Tones ```tsx Draft Sent Overdue Paid Void New ``` ## shadcn badge variants Badge accepts shadcn's variant names: default (solid accent), secondary (soft neutral), destructive (solid danger) and outline (a hairline, no fill). asChild renders a link with the badge's look. ```tsx New Draft Overdue Beta Changelog ``` Docs: https://rime.mjsons.net/components/status-pill
